children: Telenor's current share price represents an attractive buying opportunity, despite competition concerns in the Nordics that have seen the stock lose 25% of its value this year, AlphaValue analyst Jean-Michel Salvador writes. The Norwegian telecommunications provider's share price halved in 2022 due to rising interest rates affecting the sector and investor concerns about its Asian strategy and the sustainability of dividends from those operations, he says. However, the stock rebounded over the subsequent three years, reaching new highs by the end of 2025. This recovery was driven by smart moves in Asia and the consolidation of Nordic operations, which alone should now be able to cover the dividend, he adds. AlphaValue rates Telenor at add and has a 154 Norwegian kroner target price. Shares rise 0.2% to 136.90 kroner. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
